sentences.text: Page No.# 2/2 Heard Mr. S. Ahmed, learned counsel for the applicant.
Also heard Mr. R.R. Kaushik, learned Addl. P.P. Assam appearing for the State.

The applicant herein was arrested on 10-04-2023 in connection with Hojai P.S. Case No. 181/2023 registered under Section 498(A)/376/511 IPC read with Section 8 of the POCSO Act and since then,
he is in custody.
By filing this application, the applicant is seeking his released on bail.

Mr. Kaushik, learned Addl. P.P. Assam submits that this is a charge-sheeted case and therefore, the LCR will be necessary for consideration of the bail prayer.
In view of the above, Registry to call for the scanned copy of the LCR from the court of Special Judge (POCSO), Sankardev Nagar, Hojai fixing 08-11-2023.

entities.text: court of Special Judge (POCSO), Sankardev Nagar, Hojai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner to take steps for service of notice upon the victim/ respondent No. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as by usual process.
In addition, petitioner to take steps for service of notice upon the respondent No. 2 through the Officer-in-Charge of the Hojai Police Station making the notice returnable on 08-11-2023.
List again on 08-11-2023 for production of Case Diary.
